name: Bologna
intro: Explore 622 records from Bologna’s official ACER layer. 536 have an unambiguous source building code; remaining records need building-identity review. Markers use source footprint centroids.

footnote: 622 documented records; 536 source-verified buildings. Exact duplicate footprints sharing a building code were consolidated. Other repeated building codes remain explicitly under review. This is not a complete census or an occupancy check.
